name: environment-logger
description: Small multi-source environmental telemetry logger, SQLite store and LAN dashboard

scripts.check: node --check src/main.mjs && node --check src/web.mjs && node --check src/sources/homebridge.mjs && node --check src/sources/matter-direct.mjs && node --check src/sources/matter-bridge.mjs && node --check src/sources/matter-server.mjs
scripts.service-install: sudo env NODE_BINARY=$(command -v node) sh scripts/install-systemd.sh
